title: VTC Notifications — Relay — payload
description: An administrator with `vtc.notifications.relay` decides that the community relays one notification it holds to some of its members — all of them, the members of one group, or the holders of one community role — having been shown what the relay discloses about the community (VTI-NTF-046, VTI-NTF-071 – VTI-NTF-073). The community relays the document it received exactly as received, one notifications/relay/0.1 per member, never to itself, the originator or any earlier relayer, and relays every later revision to the same members without a further decision (VTI-NTF-044). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

disclosureAcknowledged.description: The administrator's statement that they were shown the notification's `relayDisclosure` and decide the relay knowing it (VTI-NTF-046). REQUIRED to be true for a notification whose kind's definition says a relay discloses something; ignored for one whose definition says nothing is disclosed.

revision.description: The revision of the notification the decision relays.

recipientCount.description: How many parties this decision added to those the notification is relayed to, each of which the community has queued one relay for. Zero when the selection reaches no member an earlier decision had not.
